main_text.p: metulantemque compesco, interponen- em serebus non suis, turbantem, fi- ‹ta cum seriis & vera cum falsis pro- miscua ducentem, excutio, insector, exagito.
main_text.head: Textus XII.
main_text.p: Genius hic, judices, cum ad omnem Metamor- Hic res nobis omnes, tam- quam homines, considerandas inculcat.phosim inclinat propendetque, tum inanima in animata transformandi longè cupidissimus est: Ipse lapides, ipse silvas, montes, urbes, fluvios, ventos, & quaevis tandem adscisicit in humanam societatem & jubet homines nobiscum esse: queri ea sæpe, sæpe lætari facit, modò dolore percita, modo spe elata, modo metu perculsa, tum amore,
main_text.notes: Left margin shows cut-off fragments of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. Opening words of the first paragraph ("cum ad omnem") were read with some uncertainty; "metulantemque compesco" line is partly cut at the left edge. Some letters of the marginal note text are small and uncertain.
